description: nhflow_3d_si_mb_basin_fine with the blocks cut into 2 x 2 tiles (G 55 8, G 58 1: 13 grids on one rank, corners of four pieces) and the two-level eta preconditioner (G 57 4: Galerkin coarse space of 4 x 4 cell aggregates across all grids, solved by sparse LU, multiplicative with the P7 Schwarz step). Equal to the uncut grid to solver tolerance (2.7e-8 m); eta iterations per pass 17.5 uncut, 22.3 tiles, 8.0 tiles + G 57.
